scope: Thirteenth delegated attended RAM-only native USB transport diagnostic; no power measurements
authority: Owner delegated lab setup and attended the Mac reboot; bounded private no-audio camera was authorized. Exact one-use procedure approved after independent review; owner did not manually read its digest.

frames.observation: DEVICE cycle page: V2, no device event latched (DD00), first configuration window open (W1).
STAGE cycle page: launch_wait (S10), no error (E0), USB state unknown (U0).
TRACE cycle page: V2, both ACM set_alt calls returned zero (A3), serial connect returned zero (G2), EP0 status start command accepted (P2).
EVENT cycle page: V2, selected status wrapper returned after accepted command (R2); no selected EP0 event latched (E0), no completion state (S0).
REARM cycle page: V2, matching event-buffer unmask after wrapper return (M2), no later event-count read observed (C0), configuration window open (W1).
Second DEVICE-cycle observation repeats no latched device event and open first configuration window.
Second TRACE-cycle observation repeats successful software setup and accepted status command.
Second EVENT-cycle observation repeats returned wrapper without selected EP0 event latched.
Second REARM-cycle observation repeats matching unmask with no later count read in the observed first window.

optical_observation.page_title_limitation: Small titles are overexposed; page assignment is corroborated by the pinned renderer cycle.
optical_observation.trace_limitation: V2 is provisional. C0, E0 and DD00 mean not observed or latched in the first configuration window; they do not prove absence of bus events, SOF, interrupts or later activity.

technical_finding: The selected EP0 status command was accepted and its wrapper returned. The matching cached event batch was unmasked; no later event-count read, selected EP0 event or device event was observed in the first configuration window before the host timeout. This rules out a missing observed rearm write for that batch but establishes no wire-level status completion or verified driver fix.
remaining_blocker: Native ACM never became usable; no payload or power sample. The specific controller/interrupt/PHY/host/cable cause is unverified. Further physical diagnosis needs an independent supported debug UART or protocol analyzer, or a separately reviewed redesign of the result channel.
